title: Sputnik Speaker
description: Speaker developed as a RenderWeekly challenge, out of curiosities about additive manufacturing through Grasshopper in Rhino, and Blender for organic forms.

brief.label: Brief
brief.text: A RenderWeekly challenge, used to explore additive manufacturing with Grasshopper in Rhino and organic modeling in Blender.

brief.label: Design response
brief.text: A spherical driver pod carried on a lattice stand, a form that only additive manufacturing could produce in one piece.

study_intro: Machined precision meets grown structure: a perfect sphere carried by something that looks like it was grown rather than built.

study.label: Form
study.text: A spherical driver pod held in a lattice stand, whose open cells could only come from additive manufacturing.

study.label: Contrast
study.text: Smooth, exact geometry at the head against an organic, branching body below. The tension between the two is the design.

study.label: Reference
study.text: Its namesake satellite: a polished sphere with a trailing antenna, echoed in the cable spike at the back of the pod.

study.label: Color
study.text: A white driver face in a dark gloss shell, presented on saturated orange and deep blue grounds like a space-age poster.
